sendNotificationPage.title: Send Notification
sendNotificationPage.description: Manually send a notification to selected users — use this to test the Push/Email/SMS channels or to send an ad-hoc notification. Each recipient still receives it according to their own channel settings (Personal notification settings).

channels.label: Force channels (optional — for testing)
channels.hint: Leave empty to send according to each recipient's real notification settings (default). Select 1+ channels to FORCE sending through exactly those channels, bypassing personal settings — useful to isolate-test one channel, e.g. Push only.
